Joy.CheerOn: Make an ally deal {Percent}% of their Attack as essence damage to any unit they hit for {Duration} turns.

Anger.HealOffStacks: Remove all your rage stacks and heal for {HealPercent}% of the removed stacks.
Anger.Rampage: Hit an enemy with {AttackPercent}% of your Attack. If this hit kills the enemy, regain all your rage stacks.

Generic.AttackHit: Hit an enemy with {AttackPercent}% of your Attack.
Generic.DoubleAttackHit: Hit an enemy with {AttackPercent}% of your Attack twice.
Generic.DoubleAttackHitUneven: Hit an enemy with {FirstAttackPercent}% and then {SecondAttackPercent}% of your Attack.
Generic.TripleAttackHit: Hit an enemy with {AttackPercent}% of your Attack three times.
Generic.TripleAttackHitUneven: Hit an enemy with {FirstAttackPercent}%, then {SecondAttackPercent}%, then {ThirdAttackPercent}% of your Attack.
Generic.TeamAttackHit: Hit all enemies with {AttackPercent}% of your Attack.
Generic.TeamDoubleAttackHit: Hit all enemies with {AttackPercent}% of your Attack twice.

Joy.CheeredOn: Deal {Percent}% of your Attack as essence damage to any unit you hit.
